id: trace-Deterministic Container Testing with Output-Based Validation in Kubectx Sandbox

definition.specificationName: Deterministic Container Testing with Output-Based Validation in Kubectx Sandbox
definition.summary: Traced implementation of deterministic container testing workflow in kubectx sandbox with output-based validation eliminating LLM dependency

currentState.validationHarnesses: 100+ harnesses with mixed LLM-dependent and output-based patterns
currentState.containerBuilds: Fragmented build scripts across repos (metabob-rpc-api, metabob-cli, metabob-opencode)
currentState.kubectxUsage: Some scripts check docker-desktop, no enforced isolation
currentState.gaps: No impulse-based expected outputs, no unified framework, no automated workflow

desiredState.workflow: Code change → build-container.sh → deploy-to-sandbox.sh → run-output-tests.sh → unified-output-validator → Pass/Fail
desiredState.validation: 100% deterministic assertions (===, !==, >, <, includes, regex), zero LLM dependency
desiredState.expectedOutputs: Stored as impulses, not hardcoded in harness files

dataFlow.current: Code change → Manual build → Manual deploy → Manual test → Human judgment
dataFlow.desired: Code change → build-container.sh → deploy-to-sandbox.sh → run-output-tests.sh → unified-output-validator → Automated pass/fail
dataFlow.exit: Structured JSON: {total_tests, passed, failed, test_results: [{test_name, passed, expected, actual, diff}]}

implementationPriority: 1. Create unified-output-validator.py - Foundation for all components
2. Create impulse templates for expected outputs
4. Create deploy-to-sandbox.sh - Enforce kubectx sandbox isolation
6. Migrate existing harnesses to unified framework
redundancyToRemove: Multiple build scripts → Single parameterized build-container.sh
Duplicate HTTP clients → Single HTTPClient in unified validator
